item.tib: rgyun khyer nar ma'i nyams len 'phrul gyis bang mdzod
item.coloph: skyabs kyi ston rin pa chen 'od zer lha dgu dang sbyar ba'i chog pa'i lag len 'phrul ngag bang mdzod 'di ni/ skyabs kyi ston pa rin chen 'od zer gyis/ 'bad dang brtson pa'i sgo nas/ gnyer chen shes rig pa'i thugs bzhed du bkod pas/ bsgrub la brtson pa rnams kyi dge spyod dam par gyur cig/
